title: Nazareth (Galilee)
summary: Nazareth is a town in lower Galilee, the Gospel home of Mary, Joseph and Jesus. Excavations under the Church of the Annunciation and nearby sites show a small Jewish agricultural village from the early first century CE, possibly from the late Hellenistic period. Later churches were built over the grotto traditionally tied to the Annunciation.

uncertainty.note: Archaeology shows occupation from at least the early first century CE and probably the Late Hellenistic period, so the true start may be earlier. End is the present, the town being inhabited.

as_recorded.value: inhabited from at least the early first century
mentioned by a pilgrim from Piacenza around 570

when.display: Inhabited from at least the early 1st century CE

where.historical_name: Village in Roman-ruled Galilee in the early first century; later Byzantine and Crusader town

importance.justification: The home village of Jesus in the Gospels and a major Christian pilgrimage place.
